summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a Turtle fixture, a parametrized valid/invalid test, and a graph-unchanged test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (39 passed). Not verified: mypy, black, ruff and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed.
